function context(overrides = {}) {
	return {
		executionId: "exec.synthetic.complete",
		tenantId: "tenant.synthetic",
		conversationId: "conversation.synthetic",
		stepNumber: 3,
		runtimeProfile: "iterative",
		agentId: "agent.synthetic",
		agentVersion: "v1",
		objective: "Host objective",
		instructions: ["Host instruction"],
		goal: "Synthetic goal",
		userMessage: "Synthetic user message",
		stateSummary: "Synthetic state",
		observations: [],
		capabilities: [],
		knowledgeAvailable: false,
		completionStrategy: "DETERMINISTIC",
		allowedDecisionTypes: ["RESPOND", "CALL_TOOL"],
		budget: {
			maxSteps: 10,
			maxModelCalls: 5,
			maxToolCalls: 5,
			maxTokens: 1e5,
			maxCostUsd: 1,
			maxDurationMs: 5e3,
			maxDecisionRepairs: 4
		},
		budgetUsage: { ...__vite_ssr_import_3__.EMPTY_BUDGET_USAGE },
		tokenBudget: 4e3,
		contextItems: [],
		correlationId: "correlation.synthetic",
		traceId: "trace.synthetic",
		toolResultContext: {
			version: 1,
			requiredObservationIds: []
		},
		...overrides
	};
}
function toolItem(output, id = "obs.tool.1", step = 1) {
	const observation = {
		observationId: id,
		executionId: "exec.synthetic.complete",
		stepId: `step.${step}`,
		stepNumber: step,
		source: "TOOL",
		type: "TOOL_RESULT",
		trust: "UNTRUSTED",
		payload: {
			schemaVersion: 1,
			status: "SUCCEEDED",
			sideEffect: "READ",
			completion: "COMPLETE",
			resultAvailability: "AVAILABLE",
			output,
			outputBytes: Buffer.byteLength(canonical(output)),
			outputSha256: digest(output)
		},
		summary: "preview must not enter system",
		provenance: {
			sourceId: "tool.echo",
			sourceVersion: "v1",
			operationKey: `op.${id}`
		},
		timestamp: "2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z"
	};
	return {
		contextId: `tool.${id}`,
		priority: "FRESH_TOOL_RESULTS",
		trust: "UNTRUSTED",
		source: "tool.echo",
		content: canonical(observation),
		tokenEstimate: 0
	};
}
function withTools(items, overrides = {}) {
	return context({
		contextItems: items,
		toolResultContext: {
			version: 1,
			requiredObservationIds: items.filter((item) => item.priority === "FRESH_TOOL_RESULTS").map((item) => JSON.parse(item.content).observationId)
		},
		...overrides
	});
}
const history = (content, priority = "OLDER_CONTEXT") => ({
	contextId: `history.${priority}`,
	priority,
	trust: "UNTRUSTED",
	source: "history",
	content,
	tokenEstimate: 0
});
const measurement = (overrides = {}) => ({
	counterId: "synthetic.counter",
	counterVersion: "1",
	provider: "synthetic",
	model: "synthetic.model",
	formattingVersion: "1",
	inputUpperBoundTokens: 100,
	contextWindowTokens: 16e3,
	costUpperBoundUsd: .01,
	...overrides
});
const result = (overrides = {}) => ({
	text: JSON.stringify(decision),
	provider: "synthetic",
	model: "synthetic.model",
	inputTokens: 80,
	outputTokens: 10,
	costUsd: .001,
	...overrides
});
function lane(ctx = context()) {
	const events = [];
	const records = [];
	const snapshots = [];
	const requests = [];
	const settlements = [];
	let liveTokens = ctx.budget.maxTokens - ctx.budgetUsage.inputTokens - ctx.budgetUsage.outputTokens;
	let liveCost = ctx.budget.maxCostUsd - ctx.budgetUsage.costUsd;
	let calls = ctx.budgetUsage.modelCalls;
	const measure = __vite_ssr_import_2__.vi.fn((request) => {
		(0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.expect)(request.maxOutputTokens).toBe(512);
		return measurement();
	});
	const reserve = __vite_ssr_import_2__.vi.fn(async (input) => {
		events.push("reserve");
		const { request, measurement: counted } = input;
		if (calls >= ctx.budget.maxModelCalls || liveTokens < counted.inputUpperBoundTokens + 512 || liveCost < counted.costUpperBoundUsd) throw new __vite_ssr_import_3__.ToolResultContextError("ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE", "Synthetic native balance exhausted", "MAX_TOKENS");
		calls += 1;
		liveTokens -= counted.inputUpperBoundTokens + 512;
		liveCost -= counted.costUpperBoundUsd;
		snapshots.push(request);
		const record = {
			admissionId: `admission.${records.length}`,
			tenantId: ctx.tenantId,
			executionId: ctx.executionId,
			stepNumber: ctx.stepNumber,
			attempt: records.length,
			purpose: request.purpose,
			requestSha256: digest(request),
			measurement: counted,
			reserved: {
				modelCalls: 1,
				inputTokens: counted.inputUpperBoundTokens,
				outputTokens: 512,
				costUsd: counted.costUpperBoundUsd
			},
			status: "RESERVED"
		};
		records.push(record);
		return record;
	});
	const settle = __vite_ssr_import_2__.vi.fn(async (input) => {
		events.push(`settle.${input.kind}`);
		settlements.push(input);
		const record = records.find((record) => record.admissionId === input.admissionId);
		if (input.kind === "UNKNOWN") return {
			...record,
			status: "UNKNOWN",
			unknownReason: input.reason
		};
		const actual = {
			modelCalls: 1,
			inputTokens: input.result.inputTokens,
			outputTokens: input.result.outputTokens,
			costUsd: input.result.costUsd
		};
		liveTokens += record.reserved.inputTokens + record.reserved.outputTokens - actual.inputTokens - actual.outputTokens;
		liveCost += record.reserved.costUsd - actual.costUsd;
		return {
			...record,
			status: "SETTLED",
			actual,
			resultSha256: digest(input.result)
		};
	});
	const complete = __vite_ssr_import_2__.vi.fn(async (request) => {
		events.push("model");
		requests.push(request);
		const { signal: _signal, ...wire } = request;
		void _signal;
		requestEvidence.push({
			request: wire,
			requestSha256: digest(wire)
		});
		const frame = JSON.parse(request.messages[1].content);
		const outputs = frame.items.filter((item) => item.priority === "FRESH_TOOL_RESULTS").map((item) => item.value.payload.output);
		return result({ text: JSON.stringify({
			...decision,
			responseText: JSON.stringify(outputs)
		}) });
	});
	requestEvidence.push({
		kind: "native-port-lane",
		events,
		records,
		snapshots,
		settlements
	});
	return {
		ctx,
		events,
		records,
		snapshots,
		requests,
		settlements,
		measure,
		reserve,
		settle,
		complete,
		options: {
			decisionModel: { complete },
			decisionInputCounter: { measure },
			decisionModelSupportsMaxOutputTokens: true
		},
		input: {
			context: ctx,
			decisionAdmission: {
				reserve,
				settle
			}
		}
	};
}

		for (const extra of [0, 1]) {
			const filler = "x".repeat(target - used + extra);
			const l = lane(context({
				instructions: [],
				userMessage: "",
				correlationId: "",
				...kind === "system" ? { instructions: [filler] } : kind === "user" ? { userMessage: filler } : { correlationId: filler }
			}));
			const pending = new __vite_ssr_import_4__.HybridOrchestrator(l.options).decide(l.input);
			if (extra === 0) {
				await pending;
				const sent = l.snapshots[0];
				(0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.expect)(kind === "system" ? sent.messages[0].content.length : kind === "user" ? sent.messages[1].content.length : Buffer.byteLength(canonical(sent))).toBe(target);
				(0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.expect)(l.complete).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
			} else {
				await (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.expect)(pending).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "CONTEXT_OVERFLOW" });
				(0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.expect)(l.complete).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
			}
		}
